recommendation_summary: The reply's main action now is to fix the counter queue today: sort the shared list by pickup date, make a short bake list of today's cakes in pickup-time order, give one person the job of marking cakes prepared, and hold next-month work until today's cakes are done. It also tells the user to keep next week's partner booking for discovery and to start an Odoo sales-order rollout as soon as today is stable. That makes the Odoo rollout a planned near-term step rather than one that depends on the bake list failing. Nothing the owner needs is left uncovered.
